theorems.name: Submission.doragm_approxTangent_lower_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < n → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → ∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, c < unitBallVolume n → ∀ᶠ ρ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), c * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) ≤ μHE[n] (M ∩ closedBall x ρ)
